unit.why: A single narrative: a lost elderly hasid spends Shabbat with a villager and, at havdalah, heals the villager's mute son with words he once received from the Maggid of Kozhnitz.

stories.start_quote: עו"ש עוד שמעתי מהגאבד״ק סעראצק דבק׳ מאקאווי
stories.summary_en: R. Lipa of Gombin, a disciple of R. Yitzhak of Warka, is lost on the road before Shabbat and lodges with Meir Zelig. Moved by his fervour, Meir Zelig's wife begs him to bless their twelve-year-old mute son. He protests that he is no rebbe, but at havdalah he recites 'borei niv sefatayim', a formula the Maggid of Kozhnitz had told him with his last words, and the boy begins to speak.
